scope: Independent scalar point-error, coverage, interval-score and paired-contrast bounds using the separately audited subdaily target enclosures.
limitations: Posthoc, previously opened sites and target scores, unknown actual missing-value range, clock, corrections, sensor accuracy, source overlap and independence. Model histories use interpolation and only 0-2 genuinely complete years. Repeated masks and the one-station 3-year subgroup do not give independent-climate accuracy or coverage guarantees. Count cases where the published-daily observed lower bound exceeds the subdaily conditional upper bound. Such cases indicate incompatibility of reporting estimands or assumptions, not evidence of hidden target leakage; do not apply an artificial projection.
